verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a 'Data Storage Location (US or EU)' choice for its hosted service. Self-hosting ("run all of Sentry on your own server"), backed by a community report of running it reliably for years, also lets users keep data wherever they want. missing for 10: in-depth first-party residency docs (the US/EU mention is a bare heading on an integration page), detail on how region is chosen or whether it can be migrated, regions beyond US/EU, and independent corroboration of hosted region selection.
